Happy 6 months, ❤️

Six months ago, I didn't know that one person could become such a huge part of my everyday life.

Somehow you became the person I want to tell everything to, the person I want beside me, and the person who can make me smile with the smallest things.

I love your little things — your momos obsession, your french fries, your expressions, your random habits, and especially the way you always want to be with me.

We've made so many memories already, from our little outings to all the random moments that probably wouldn't mean much to anyone else but mean everything to me.

You're not just my girlfriend. You're my . ❤️

Happy 6 months, baby.

And yes... I still want more of you, more memories, more stupid conversations, more food dates, more teasing, more hugs, more everything.

This is only chapter 6.

I want to see what the rest of our story looks like. ❤️
